decision_rule: PANEL_ACQUISITION_PLAN_READY iff subset_size==10, all subset assets verified/mapped/cap-present/gap-unfilled with non-empty required_study_months, frozen hashes match, and bounded (symbol,kind,month) plan is complete and unique; else LIMITED.
interpretation: EXPLORATORY_ONLY design/planning artifact from committed metadata only. Plan entries are bounded acquisition targets, NOT proof of archive publication, not downloaded data, not panels, and not outcomes. No network access performed; no returns/spreads/states/p-values/costs/inference computed. Cannot validate, replace, or unlock H1/H6/H7/H10 or any confirmatory track. Any future keyless probe/download requires separate bounded preregistered acquisition step with provenance/SHA256 and must not fabricate missing data.
label: PANEL_ACQUISITION_PLAN_READY

subset_selection.rule: sort by cap_obs_in_study_window desc, cap_coverage_frac desc, asset asc; take first 10 gap-unfilled verified candidates
